mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% in the month prior to the decision is interpreted as a preemptive tightening by the FOMC, which raises expected discount rates and reduces near-term equity valuations, thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% in the month before decision
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the 30-day prior period (t-test p > 0.05) during FOMC pre-tightening windows.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent declines in CPIAUCSL (CPI) over three consecutive months indicate accelerating inflation expectations, prompting market participants to discount future earnings more aggressively and thereby lowering S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL declines for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than the 30-day prior window (t-test p > 0.05) during multi-month CPI declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in PAYEMS (labor market employment) coinciding with a sustained drop in UNRATE (unemployment rate) suggests a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer demand and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by at least 2% in a month while UNRATE falls by at least 0.2 percentage points in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive relative to the prior 5-day window (t-test p > 0.05) during labor market strengthening episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly increase in GDPC1 (real private consumption) above trend, with no offsetting drop in INDPRO (industrial production), signals robust consumer demand that supports equity valuations and yields positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 above trend for two consecutive months and INDPRO below trend for those months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (median of prior 20-day windows) during such demand cycles (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO (industrial production) accompanied by a sustained rise in HOUST (housing starts) indicates a shift from manufacturing to service-driven supply growth, which reduces capacity pressures and supports higher S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for two consecutive months while HOUST rises for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day prior window during such supply rebalancing episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in PAYEMS (labor market activity) followed by a sharp drop in UNRATE (unemployment) within the same week signals a tight labor market that raises wage growth expectations and supports equity risk premia, producing positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by at least 3% in a week and UNRATE falls by at least 0.3 percentage points in the same week
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive relative to the prior 5-day window (t-test p > 0.05) during such labor market transitions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in RSAFS (money supply growth) for three consecutive quarters, in the absence of a parallel decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation), is interpreted as a disinflationary policy stance that lowers growth expectations and produces negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls for three consecutive quarters while CPIAUCSL does not decline
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the 10-day prior window during disinflationary quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in INDPRO (industrial production) without a corresponding rise in GDPC1 (private consumption) suggests weakening overall economic momentum that depresses corporate earnings expectations and results in negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for four consecutive months while GDPC1 remains flat or declines
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the 30-day prior window during such episodes (Rank IC > 0.10).
